title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer AWS and Azure
description:
On behalf of a partner company, Nordic Investin is looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer AWS and Azure. You want technical choices, delivery and production behaviour to reinforce each other, even when the constraints are difficult.


The partner is strengthening its capability in preventative and detective security controls across multi-cloud environments. You will connect cloud IAM, security posture management and infrastructure as code while ensuring that logging and incident support receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.


The environment rewards early questions, visible trade-offs and engineering discipline. Security and operability belong in the design.

### **How you will work**


You will work with product, architecture, security, operations and domain colleagues. The partner values short feedback loops, evidence from real systems and direct communication.


This role calls for independent judgement and the ability to raise the quality around you. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**


Own the practical direction for preventative and detective security controls across multi-cloud environments.


Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for cloud IAM and security posture management.


Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around infrastructure as code.


Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting logging.


Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve incident support.


Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through automation.

### **What you will bring**


Relevant experience delivering preventative and detective security controls across multi-cloud environments in a demanding environment.


Strong working knowledge of cloud IAM and security posture management.


Practical experience applying infrastructure as code and logging.


Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving incident support.


Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.


Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.


Experience that would add value


Experience from cloud-native companies and regulated enterprises.


Exposure to automation in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.


Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.


A background that can succeed here


Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of preventative and detective security controls across multi-cloud environments is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.


What makes the opportunity interesting


The role offers meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on preventative and detective security controls across multi-cloud environments gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.


The recruitment conversation


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.



We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.



You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

  

**This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.**


**The opportunity:**



Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.



It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.



You'll join the **Product Analytics team**, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.


**About the product:**



The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:


* **Frontend:** a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
* **Backend:** Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
* **Feature flags:** integration with **OpenFeature** and the **OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP)**, Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
* **Statistics engine:** a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
* **Data:** experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
* **AI:** experiment authoring assisted by **Grafana Assistant**, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.


**What You’ll be doing:**


* **Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product.** Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
* **Build the experimentation experience.** Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
* **Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust**. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
* **Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack.** Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see *why* a variant won, not only *that* it won.
* **Harden the statistics and analysis path.** Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
* **Use AI where it genuinely helps.** Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
* **Raise the engineering bar.** Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
* **Own what you ship.** Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.


We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.


**What makes you a great fit:**



We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.


* **Strong full-stack engineering experience.** You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
* **Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform** (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
* **Product and data intuition.** You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
* **Technical ownership.** You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
* **Operational responsibility.** You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
* **Pragmatic AI usage.** You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed *and* quality.
* **Clear communication.** You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.


**Bonus Points For:**


* Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
* A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
* Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
* Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
* Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
* Open source contribution or maintainership.
* Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

  


**Compensation & Rewards:**



In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 814,000 - SEK 1,017,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

  





* *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.*


**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**


* **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* **Open Source Roots** – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* **In-Person onboarding** - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* **Balance is Key** - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.*


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*


*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*



#LI-Remote

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:
**Company Description**  

At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.


Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.


This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.


We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.


What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.


If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.

 **Job Description*** We are looking for a new Professional Services Consultant with strong and proven professional services experience in IT and network security. The Professional Services Consultant will require a high level of expertise in Check Point software technologies products for on-premises deployment or in the Cloud. The consultant will be required to work on-site and remotely in the performance of their duties. The Professional Services consultant will implement Check Point technologies with a focus on maintaining the highest levels of integrity and Customer Satisfaction and is expected to maintain a professional, courteous and customer service-focused attitude at all times.


If you are a proven post-sales consultant who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to speak with you.
* Deliver PS engagements in accordance with Check Point Professional Services standards
* Provide security consultancy to some of Check Point’s largest customers.
* Provide integration and implementation services of Check Point’s High-End products in complex networking environments
* Provide Technical Account Management duties with key accounts as required.
* Provide product training and workshops to customers if required.
* Developing Methods of Procedures (MOP) and Low-Level designs (LLD) to meet customers’ criteria
* Developing test plans and testing new features and products before deploying them in production
* Trouble-shooting Check Point products when required
* Work in collaboration with sales, R&D, TAC and other Check Point teams to ensure customer satisfaction

  

**Qualifications**  

* At least 5-8+ years of experience with IP-based networks, network design, and security products.
* Solid understanding of network infrastructure (routing, switching, load balancing) and security products (firewall, VPN, IPS, Anti-Virus, Application Control)
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP and cyber security concepts
* Experience with IP based networks, network design, security products & protocols
* Experience with Check Point GAIA Operating system
* Experience with implementing, migrating, upgrading and optimizing Check Point’s high-end products in complex network environments.
* Experience with several different operating systems: Windows, Linux, etc
* Experience with VSX, Multi-Domain Security Management (MDSM) and Scalable Platforms preferred
* Check Point certified (CCSA, CCSE); CCSM, CCSME preferred
* Good Linux command line knowledge preferred
* Scripting skills and knowledge of automation tools such as Ansible a plus
* Experience with Check Point Harmony and CloudGuard experience a plus
* Ability to work independently and as a team player
* Customer-oriented, and post-sales experience with direct face-to-face service
* Excellent oral and written communication skills in English and Swedish is essential.

  

**Additional Information**  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Office Coordinator
description:
**Who we are:**



For over 25 years, Global Relay has set the standard in enterprise information archiving with industry-leading cloud archiving, surveillance, eDiscovery, and analytics solutions. We securely capture and preserve the communications data of the world's most highly regulated firms, giving them greater visibility and control over their information and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations.



Though we offer competitive compensation and benefits and all the other perks one would expect from an established company, we are not your typical technology company. Global Relay is a career-building company. A place for big ideas. New challenges. Groundbreaking innovation. It's a place where you can genuinely make an impact – and be recognized for it.



We believe great businesses thrive on diversity, inclusion, and the contributions of all employees. To that end, we recruit candidates from different backgrounds and foster a work environment that encourages employees to collaborate and learn from each other, completely free of barriers.

**Job Purpose:**



The Office Coordinator provides comprehensive support to the daily processes and business operations of our fast-paced organisation.


**Duties and responsibilities**


**Administration and office security protocols:**


* Ensure day to day administrative tasks are completed in a timely manner
* Answer and direct calls as appropriate to the relevant team
* Arrange and document courier collection and deliveries
* Support HR and business operations with new hire onboarding including office tours and arranging access passes.
* Greet and check in visitors, adhering to office security procedures
* Comply with emergency out of hours office procedures, maintaining accurate records
* Liaise with building management to allow access as required


**Events:**


* Assist with in-house events: both internal and external events
* Arrange external catering and provide support in-house as and when required
* Ensure ad hoc meeting requirements are fulfilled as directed: printing, AV equipment, refreshments, room set up etc.


**Vendor Relationships:**


* Source external vendors and contractors and maintain strategic relationships with them to ensure optimal cost, compatibility and efficiency for the business
* Ensure equipment, repairs and maintenance are resolved in a timely manner, to a high standard
* Manage the ordering and maintenance contract for workplace coffee facilities, ensuring ordering and service level agreements are adhered to
* Manage relationship with the building management team, escalating any issues that arise and ensuring access to the building is granted as required
* Responsible for overseeing the daily cleaning of the office and ensuring all works completed are to a satisfactory standard
* Responsible for maintaining overall appearance and presentation of the workplace, including reception area, meeting rooms, plant displays and kitchenette areas.
* Oversee office facilities, ensuring all are in good working order
* Coordinate repairs with building management and contractors
* Handle issues and tasks on behalf of Director of Business Operations and other department heads


**Health and Safety:**


* Manage health and safety compliance: workplace safety, fire safety and related procedures
* Responsible for overseeing first aid and ensuring accident reporting protocols are followed
* Manage and schedule planned preventative maintenance (PPMs), updating records of works as appropriate
* Conduct relevant risk assessments as required
* Be the main point of contact for office employees: welfare and general day to day management of employees, escalate any matters to the appropriate department as required
* Maintain H&S records and ensure good practice is in place and adhered to
* Create and maintain an overview of annual mandatory requirements for all health and safety aspects of the workplace


**Accounting:**


* Review and approve office purchases and services.
* Invoice reconciliation and approval.
* Responsibility of overseeing corporate credit card for office-related purchases and retrieving invoices for finance processing.


**Qualifications:**


* 3+ years of administrative office management experience
* Post-Secondary education is preferred
* Ability to speak and write Swedish and English fluently and possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills with excellent telephone etiquette
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint & Outlook)
* Good judgment to proactively and independently solve problems and make decisions
* Exceptional time-management, organizational, and prioritizing skills with great attention to detail
* Strong work ethic with a willingness to multi-task and be flexible to take on varied responsibilities
* Ability to exercise tact and discretion, and can be entrusted with confidential information
* Goal oriented self-starter who can work independently and reliably with minimal supervision and has an appetite for continuous learning
* A friendly, "can-do" attitude and customer focused approach

**What you can expect:**



At Global Relay, there's no ceiling to what you can achieve. It's the land of opportunity for the energetic, the intelligent, the driven. You'll receive the mentoring, coaching, and support you need to reach your career goals. You'll be part of a culture that breeds creativity and rewards perseverance and hard work. And you'll be working alongside smart, talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with complementary knowledge and skills.



Global Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion.



We seek to ensure reasonable adjustments, accommodations, and personal time are tailored to meet the unique needs of every individual.



To learn more about our business, culture, and community involvement, visit www.globalrelay.com.

title: Contract and Privacy Manager Public 360°- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
Stockholm, Sweden


* Full-time


* Delivery, Project and Product Management


* Onsite


* Tieto Indtech

  
Job Description  

  

**Contract and Privacy Manager Public 360°- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)**


**Ready to bring privacy, contracts and product development together?**


At Public 360°, we are looking for someone who can make complex contract and privacy matters clear and actionable. As Privacy and Contract Manager at Tieto, you will work closely with Sales, Legal, Privacy and Product to connect customer commitments, commercial agreements and product development.


This role is dedicated to Public 360° and the development and delivery of the product. Public 360° is a Nordic platform for case and document management in the public sector, helping organisations connect workflows, support decision-making and simplify everyday work for employees and citizens.


Based in the sales organisation, you will be a key partner when assessing customer needs, negotiating agreements and embedding privacy throughout the product lifecycle. You will conduct initial legal and privacy reviews, negotiate within your authority and involve Group Legal and Privacy in complex matters. Overall legal responsibility and final legal review remain with Group Legal.  

  



**Why this could be your next move**


This is an opportunity to combine commercial understanding with contract management and hands-on privacy work in a Nordic product environment. Working closely with both customer-facing teams and product development, you will help Public 360° turn requirements into workable agreements, effective processes and privacy built in from the start.  

  

  



**What you will do**


**Contracts and commercial agreements**


* Draft and review customer contracts, Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), amendments and responses to Requests for Information (RFIs), using standardised templates and checklists.
* Conduct initial legal and privacy reviews, identify deviations from standard terms and flag risks to Group Legal.
* Negotiate customer contracts and DPAs within your authority, escalating complex legal and privacy matters to Group Legal and Privacy.
* Develop and maintain contract and DPA templates for different markets, and establish a structured process for incorporating new or updated terms.
* Maintain an organised contract repository, track versions, amendments, contract status and renewal dates, and follow up on alignment with relevant laws, regulations and internal policies.

**Privacy in Public 360°**


* Drive operational privacy work for Public 360° and related services throughout their lifecycle, from early development through delivery.
* Partner with Product on privacy governance and privacy by design, translating privacy requirements into practical guidance for the product roadmap, architecture and design.
* Conduct and maintain Privacy Impact Assessments and Privacy Risk Assessments, and highlight how customer requirements affect product design.
* Develop and maintain privacy processes, contribute to the Release Management Process and follow up on audit findings and remediation.
* Maintain customer-facing privacy documentation, handle privacy incidents with appropriate escalation, and assess suppliers and subcontractors against Tieto’s privacy standards.

**Advice and collaboration**


* Act as an approachable partner for Sales and Product on GDPR, data handling, regulatory interpretation and privacy requirements in customer engagements.
* Engage early in high-risk sales opportunities to identify legal complexity and privacy considerations.
* Assess the feasibility of requirements relating to data residency, sub-processors and compliance, and translate agreed positions into clear contractual terms.
* Work with Product to ensure customer privacy commitments are understood and deliverable, highlighting gaps between requirements and current product capabilities.

Keep Sales informed about contract status, terms and escalation timelines, helping customer engagements move forward with clear expectations.  
* 

**What you bring**


* A legal background is an advantage, but not essential if you have at least three years of contract management experience in B2B SaaS, software or services, together with experience in sub-processor management.
* An understanding of Data Processing Agreements and GDPR fundamentals, and familiarity with tender processes.
* Experience working in a Nordic organisation, with fluency in English and one of the Scandinavian languages.
  

**Your approach**


* You make legal and privacy topics understandable for colleagues without a legal background.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and comfortable working to tight deadlines in a sales-driven environment.
* You take initiative, anticipate needs and raise potential issues before they escalate.
* You enjoy taking ownership of your work while finding solutions together with others.

If you hold a professional certification in contract management, such as CPCM or CCM, we would love to hear about it.  

* 

**Ready to join us?**


Would you like to use your contract and privacy experience to contribute to the continued development of Public 360°? We look forward to hearing from you.

  

**Employment:** Full-time


**Reports to:** Head of Sales


**Location:** Denmark, with Norway or Sweden as possible alternatives
  

  

**Questions about the role?** Contact Keld Zornig, Head of Sales Public 360°, at keld.zornig@tieto.com

  

  

Additional Information  

  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
  

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto


**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**
  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

  
We provide customers across different industries with mission-critical solutions through our specialized software businesses Tieto Caretech, Tieto Banktech and Tieto Indtech as well as Tieto Tech Consulting business.


Our around 14 000 talented vertical software, design, cloud and AI experts are dedicated to empowering our customers to succeed and innovate with latest technology.


Tieto’s annual revenue is approximately EUR 2 billion. The company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

title: Junior marknadskoordinator
description:
**Junior marknadskoordinator till Säkra**


Vill du vara med och bygga ett av Sveriges mest spännande varumärken inom försäkring, pension och sparande?


Säkra befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsfas. I september 2026 lanserade vi vår nya varumärkesidentitet och nu fortsätter arbetet med att utveckla, stärka och etablera vårt varumärke på marknaden.


Vi söker nu en driven och kreativ junior marknadskoordinator med 1–3 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som vill bli en del av vårt team inom Marknad & Kommunikation. Rollen passar dig som trivs med att arbeta operativt, har ett öga för detaljer och tycker om att omsätta idéer till färdigt kommunikationsmaterial.

**Om rollen**


Som junior marknadskoordinator får du en bred och varierad roll med stort fokus på produktion och operativt genomförande. Du blir en viktig del av det dagliga arbetet inom Marknad & Kommunikation och bidrar till att stötta verksamheten med kommunikations- och marknadsföringsinsatser.


Du arbetar nära dina kollegor i marknads- och kommunikationsteamet och har löpande kontakt med olika delar av organisationen. Arbetet omfattar såväl digitala som tryckta kanaler och du får möjlighet att vara med och vidareutveckla Säkras nya varumärke.

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**

* Producera och anpassa marknads- och kommunikationsmaterial för digitala och tryckta kanaler.
* Ta fram presentationer, säljmaterial, produktblad, annonser och annat grafiskt material enligt Säkras visuella identitet.
* Stötta verksamheten med löpande kommunikations- och produktionsbehov.
* Producera och publicera innehåll för webbplats, intranät och sociala medier.
* Planera, producera och genomföra digitala nyhetsbrev och e-postutskick.
* Bidra till produktion och redigering av enklare bild- och videomaterial.
* Stötta vid planering och genomförande av event, kampanjer och andra marknadsaktiviteter.
* Säkerställa att kommunikationsmaterial håller hög kvalitet och följer Säkras grafiska riktlinjer.

**Vem är du?**


Vi söker dig som är i början av din karriär och har något eller några års erfarenhet av att arbeta med marknadsföring och kommunikation. Du har en god grund att stå på, trivs med operativt arbete och vill fortsätta utveckla din kompetens inom området.


Du är kreativ, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad med en stark vilja att lära dig nya saker. Du trivs i en miljö där tempot stundtals är högt och där arbetsuppgifterna kan variera från dag till dag.


Du har lätt för att prioritera, är prestigelös och tycker om att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Vi tror att du är en person som både ser helheten och har öga för detaljer. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och är inte rädd för att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs.

**Vi söker dig som har**

* Universitets- eller högskoleutbildning inom marknadsföring, kommunikation, medieproduktion eller motsvarande.
* 1–3 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom marknadsföring, kommunikation eller grafisk produktion, gärna från en liknande operativ roll.
* Goda kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud, framför allt InDesign och Illustrator.
* Mycket god vana av Microsoft 365, särskilt PowerPoint, Word och Excel.
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska samt goda kunskaper i engelska.
* God känsla för grafisk formgivning, layout och visuell kommunikation.
* Förmåga att arbeta självständigt, strukturerat och hantera flera parallella arbetsuppgifter.
* Ett serviceinriktat och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt.

**Det är meriterande om du har**

* Erfarenhet av Apsis eller liknande verktyg för e-postmarknadsföring.
* Erfarenhet av webbpublicering och innehållshanteringssystem (CMS).
* Kunskaper i Premiere Pro eller andra verktyg för videoredigering.
* Tidigare erfarenhet från en marknads- eller kommunikationsavdelning inom bank och försäkring.

**Vad erbjuder vi?**


Hos Säkra får du möjlighet att vara med på en spännande tillväxtresa och bidra till utvecklingen av ett starkt varumärke. Du blir en del av en organisation med höga ambitioner, stort engagemang och korta beslutsvägar.


Du får en varierad roll där du arbetar nära verksamheten, utvecklar din kompetens och får möjlighet att ta ett växande ansvar över tid.


Som en del av Marknad & Kommunikation blir du en viktig pusselbit i arbetet med att etablera och vidareutveckla Säkras nya varumärke.

**Ansökan**  

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomför vi en bakgrundskontroll.


Omfattning: Heltid  

Placeringsort: Stockholm  

Startdatum: Snarast möjligast.


Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Business Analyst ERP/IFS
description:
Har du erfarenhet av IFS och ett starkt intresse för att utveckla och optimera affärssystem inom Supply Chain och Manufacturing? För kunds räkning söker vi en erfaren Business Analyst inom ERP med särskild kompetens inom IFS, Supply Chain och Manufacturing. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta verksamhetsnära i en tekniskt komplex miljö där du bidrar till att utveckla effektiva, hållbara och kostnadseffektiva systemlösningar. Om uppdraget Som Business Analyst inom ERP har du en central roll i att analysera verksamhetens behov och omsätta dessa till ändamålsenliga systemlösningar.
  
  

Du arbetar med att utvärdera befintliga lösningar, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och säkerställa att ERP-systemet stödjer verksamhetens processer och långsiktiga mål. Uppdraget har särskilt fokus på IFS inom Supply Chain och Manufacturing, där du bidrar med både verksamhetsförståelse och systemkompetens för att skapa effektiva och förvaltningsbara lösningar. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Analysera verksamhetens behov, krav och befintliga ERP-lösningar. Utvärdera och förbättra systemfunktionalitet inom IFS, med fokus på Supply Chain och Manufacturing.
  
  

Identifiera möjligheter till effektivisering, standardisering och optimering av affärsprocesser. Omsätta verksamhetskrav till hållbara och kostnadseffektiva systemlösningar. Säkerställa att ERP-lösningarna är användarvänliga, förvaltningsbara och anpassade efter verksamhetens behov. Bidra till analys och utvärdering av systemfunktionalitet och tekniska förbättringsmöjligheter.
  
  

Samarbeta med verksamhetsrepresentanter och tekniska specialister för att säkerställa väl fungerande lösningar. Vi söker dig som har Erfarenhet av arbete som Business Analyst, ERP-specialist eller i en liknande verksamhetsnära roll. God kompetens inom IFS ERP, särskilt inom Supply Chain och Manufacturing. Erfarenhet av kravanalys, verksamhetsprocesser och utvärdering av affärssystem.
  
  

Förmåga att identifiera förbättringsområden och föreslå effektiva systemlösningar. God förståelse för sambandet mellan verksamhetens behov, systemfunktionalitet och långsiktig förvaltning. Meriterande kompetenser Det är särskilt värdefullt om du även har erfarenhet av: Verksamhetsnära ERP-funktionalitet inom tillverkande industri. Analys och utvärdering av funktionalitet i IFS Cloud.
  
  

Teknisk förståelse för instanshantering och prestandaoptimering. Förbättring och effektivisering av processer inom produktion, materialflöden och Supply Chain. Låter detta som ett intressant uppdrag? Sök redan i dag eller kontakta oss så berättar vi gärna mer.
  
  

Vi behöver en ansökan inkluderat CV och personligt brev på svenska som matchar vår kunds krav. Kunden kan fatta beslut tidigare än sista ansökningsdatum, urval och intervjuer sker löpande. NXT Interim och NXT Rekrytering är ett nischat och innovativt företag som är verksamma inom konsult och rekryteringsbranschen. Vi är verksamma inom HR, IT, Ekonomi, Sälj och Marknad och har över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen.
  
  

Vi erbjuder våra konsulter bl.a sjukförsäkring, remote-arbetsplatser och flera andra förmåner som förgyller deras vardag. Vid anställning tillämpar vi kollektivavtal.

title: ISD Head
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------



The ISD Head will provide strategic and operational leadership for enterprise application, SAP, AI/digital, and infrastructure services, ensuring seamless end-to-end technology delivery across the organization. The role requires a senior technology leader with proven experience managing SAP landscapes, application portfolios, cloud and infrastructure services, AI-led transformation, service delivery, and large-scale transformation programs. The incumbent will be accountable for technology strategy execution, operational stability, modernization, customer experience, financial performance, and delivery excellence.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Key Responsibilities 1. Integrated Technology Delivery Own end-to-end delivery across Applications, SAP, Infrastructure, Cloud, Integration and Digital/AI platforms. Establish an integrated operating model across application development, infrastructure operations, platform engineering and managed services. Ensure strong governance around SLA/KPI performance, availability, incident management, problem management, capacity, security, resilience and business continuity. Drive collaboration between application, infrastructure, architecture, security and business teams. 2. SAP & Enterprise Applications Provide leadership for complex SAP S/4HANA and ECC environments, including transformation, migration, AMS and optimization programs. Oversee SAP functional and technical landscapes covering areas such as Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Sales, HR and Integration. Drive modernization using SAP BTP, Fiori, Integration Suite, analytics, automation and cloud technologies. Govern enterprise application architecture and reduce application complexity and technical debt. 3. AI, Automation & Digital Transformation Define and execute the enterprise AI and GenAI adoption roadmap, aligned with measurable business outcomes. Identify AI opportunities across IT operations, application development, business processes, knowledge management and customer/user experience. Drive adoption of GenAI, intelligent automation, AIOps, predictive analytics and AI-assisted software engineering. Establish appropriate governance for responsible AI, security, data privacy and enterprise-scale adoption. Partner with business leadership to move AI initiatives from PoCs into scalable production solutions. 4. Infrastructure, Cloud & Operations Lead integrated infrastructure services covering cloud, data center, network, workplace, compute, storage, middleware and platform services. Drive hybrid and multi-cloud transformation, infrastructure modernization and automation. Ensure high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, cybersecurity alignment and operational resilience of enterprise platforms. Improve infrastructure efficiency through standardization, observability, FinOps, automation and AIOps. 5. Transformation & Architecture Create a multi-year technology transformation roadmap spanning SAP, applications, AI, cloud and infrastructure modernization. Drive architecture rationalization, platform consolidation and legacy modernization. Ensure technology investments support scalability, security, interoperability and business growth. Sponsor large and complex transformation programs involving multiple geographies, vendors and business functions. 6. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead large, multidisciplinary teams across SAP, Applications, Infrastructure, Cloud, Architecture, AI and Service Management. Partner with CIO/CTO-level stakeholders and business leadership to translate business strategy into technology priorities. Build strong engineering and delivery leadership capability across internal and partner organizations. Manage senior relationships with strategic technology partners and system integrators. 7. Commercial & Vendor Management Own technology budgets, workforce plans, vendor ecosystems and managed-service engagements. Drive cost optimization while maintaining service quality and transformation velocity.

title: Azure Cloud Architect who loves mentoring, top tier projects and humble peers?
description:
Most leadership roles pull you further and further away from the code until you’re just managing Jira tickets and staring at slide decks.


That’s a hard pass for us.


We believe the most effective Tech Leads are player-coaches: engineers who have earned the scars in production, still love the thrill of solving complex problems hands-on, and genuinely enjoy helping other developers level up.


We want an **Azure Tech Lead,** who bridges the gap between high-level architectural strategy and the daily realities of engineering, to join our Cloud squad. You’re just as comfortable pitching a robust cloud migration strategy to C-level stakeholders as you are diving into a repository to help unblock a team member on an Azure pipeline. You set the direction, you set the standard, and you build right alongside the crew.

### **The 75/25 Split (Give or Take)**


We believe the best leaders stay sharp by keeping their hands dirty. You can expect a solid chunk of hands-on engineering work. Not because someone forces you to, but because you actually want to.

* **The Build Days:** You’re in the flow, designing landing zones, writing IaC, deploying services, and pair-programming with the team.
* **The "Consultancy" Days:** Some clients need extra guidance and strategic care. When complexity spikes, you shift effortlessly into a 50/50 balance, anchoring deep architectural decisions while managing stakeholder expectations and steering the delivery roadmap.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Driving the Ship:** This isn't an administrative or check-the-box role. You are a Tech Lead in every sense: taking technical ownership and guiding project delivery from concept to "it's live and rock solid."
* **Translating "Tech" to "Human":** You’ll be discussing cloud governance and migration roadmaps with Directors and Engineering Managers one hour, and troubleshooting an Azure pipeline with a developer the next. You speak both languages fluently.
* **Managing the Vibe:** You know how to guide people, clear blockers, and align expectations in an open, friendly, and inclusive way. We value autonomy, pragmatism, and, most importantly, being someone people actually enjoy collaborating with every day.

### **Who You Are**


As a person, you are collaborative, open-minded, kind and easy-going (no ss-hats are wanted or needed).


Technology has likely been a central curiosity for most of your life. Maybe you started out taking apart computers, tinkering with games, or simply had that persistent itch that said, *"I need to understandhow this works under the hood."*


You probably began your career in software development, systems engineering, or DevOps/platform engineering. Along the way, you realized you don't just love the systems, you love unlocking potential in other engineers and guiding a team toward a shared win.

#### **Tech Skills**

* Architectural-level in Microsoft Azure
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* CI/CD & Automation
* Container Orchestration
* Observability & Reliability
* Security & Compliance

**Bonus Points (read:** ***not*** **mandatory)**

* Solid development or scripting background in languages like Python, Go, C#/.NET, or PowerShell—making automation and platform engineering feel like second nature.
* Relevant Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert or DevOps Engineer Expert).
* Multi-cloud awareness (AWS or GCP).

### **Language Requirement**


Fluency in Swedish is a **very-nice-to-have**, and English is an **absolute must**.

*Why? Because many of our collaborations and client environments in Stockholm operate in Swedish, while our technical dialogue and documentation often happen in English.*

### **Let's Play!**


Applying to us is straightforward:

* Upload your CV or link your LinkedIn profile.
* Answer a couple of quick questions (no "please-rewrite-your-resume" nonsense, promise).
* Feel free to drop a link to your GitHub, architecture write-ups, or anything technical you're proud of.

**Please Note:**


Playground Group does not provide visa sponsorship or relocation support. Applicants must already hold a permanent and independent right to work in Sweden *and* reside in the greater Stockholm area.

### **Welcome to Playground Group!**


At Playground, you work on real, complex assignments for well-established and ambitious clients—not sideline bench projects or throwaway experiments. Our teams are trusted with production environments, platforms, and mission-critical cloud infrastructure that actually matters.


Here, professional growth comes from genuine ownership, shared curiosity, and taking pride in doing the work properly. You’re trusted to think, contribute, and elevate your craft, one meaningful step at a time.


Playground brings together specialized domains under one roof—combining an open culture and pragmatic engineering philosophy with direct access to deep technical expertise across modern tech stacks.

**Buzzword Bingo:** Azure, Bicep, Terraform, AKS, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Helm, Docker, Kubernetes, Key Vault, API Management, Python, Go, C#/.NET, PowerShell, Azure Landing Zones, Cloud Adoption Framework, Entra ID, networking, security, and governance, Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, Azure DevOps, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), telemetry, alerting, and monitoring, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Datadog, Grafana, zero-trust models, secret management (Azure Key Vault), cloud security posture. Playground Cloud Tech.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**About the job**
-----------------


Collective Minds is a Stockholm-based healthtech company whose cloud-based medical imaging platform connects hospitals, researchers and industry partners, supporting collaboration, research and education through innovative technology.


With a strong foundation in radiology and healthcare, an established customer base across the Nordics and ambitions to expand further in Europe, Collective Minds is looking for a commercially driven Business Development Manager to help take the business to the next level. You will join a founder-led company where you can take ownership, influence decisions and make a real impact.

**The Role**
------------


As Business Development Manager, you will drive business growth across Europe while managing and developing Collective Minds' existing customer portfolio in Sweden, Norway and Denmark.


You will focus on strengthening long-term relationships with universities, academic hospitals and healthcare institutions across the Nordics, while identifying and winning new business for our research and education platforms in the wider European market.


The role combines account management with proactive new business development. You will take ownership of customer relationships, drive renewals and account expansion, and manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing deals.


Working closely with colleagues across Sales & Marketing, Product and Customer Support, you will have the independence to drive your own commercial activities and play a key role in Collective Minds' continued growth.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Manage and develop existing customer relationships across the Nordics, focusing on retention, renewals and account expansion.
* Proactively identify, approach and win new customers across Europe for Collective Minds' research and education platforms.
* Build relationships with clinicians, researchers, educators, procurement teams and other key decision-makers.
* Lead customer meetings, prepare proposals, negotiate agreements and close deals.
* Identify upselling opportunities and develop existing accounts.
* Maintain a structured sales pipeline with clear priorities and reliable forecasts.
* Represent Collective Minds at customer meetings, conferences and relevant industry events.
* Collaborate with internal teams to support customer satisfaction and long-term business growth.

**Your Profile**
----------------


You enjoy the commercial side of business development, from opening doors and winning new customers to building relationships that last. You know how to identify opportunities, understand customer needs and turn conversations into results.


You are proactive, confident in managing sales processes and comfortable engaging with different stakeholders. Taking ownership comes naturally to you, and you enjoy working independently while being part of a collaborative team.


You thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where decisions are made quickly and where you can influence how things are done. You do not need to be an expert in medical imaging, but you are curious about healthcare, technology and how technical solutions create value.

#### **We believe you bring:**

* Around 5 years of relevant B2B sales experience, ideally combining new business development and account management.
* Experience selling technical solutions, software, SaaS or services within healthcare, life sciences, medtech or another relevant B2B environment.
* A proven track record of generating new business, developing customer relationships and closing deals.
* Experience managing sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
* Strong communication, relationship-building and negotiation skills.
* A proactive, structured and results-oriented approach to sales.
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written.
* Based in Stockholm or willing to relocate.
* Willingness to travel regularly.

#### **It is a plus if you also bring**

* Experience selling to universities, hospitals, healthcare institutions or other public-sector organizations.
* Familiarity with public procurement processes.
* Experience within medical imaging, clinical trials or research software.
* An established network within healthcare or academia.
* Knowledge of another Nordic language.

**Application**
---------------


Collective Minds is looking forward to hearing from you! Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so apply as soon as possible.


For questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact **Lotta Modin Jakobsson** at **lotta.modin@cmrad.com** or +46 70 330 11 30.

**About Collective Minds**
--------------------------


Collective Minds has more than 50 employees, with headquarters in Stockholm, software engineering in Barcelona and a team in the UK. The company combines deep expertise in medical imaging with cloud-based technology supporting collaboration, research, education and clinical trials. With international ambitions and an entrepreneurial culture, Collective Minds offers an environment where initiative is encouraged, decisions are made quickly and individual contributions make a difference.

title: Digital Solutions Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

 **About the Opportunity**

  

Ericsson Sourcing is seeking early-career engineers and digital builders who combine strong technical ability with business curiosity and people skills. These roles are being created to re-imagine how work in Sourcing should be done in an AI-first world; using technology to deliver tangible business and commercial value, not simply digitising today’s processes.

  

Embedded with Sourcing and related teams, you will work directly with colleagues to understand their workflows and uncover opportunities for meaningful change. This is not a traditional IT requirements role: you will challenge assumptions, shape the problem, and independently build and test solutions using code, AI, agents, automation and data. When an approach needs deeper integration or enterprise deployment, you will partner with Ericsson’s technology specialists to take it further.

  

We are recruiting for eight positions through one shared recruitment funnel, with placements across different teams and sourcing areas. These may include semiconductors, legal services, power generators and other categories. You do not need prior expertise in a specific category; you will learn the relevant business context in the role.

 **What you will do:**

* Build working solutions, develop and test AI-enabled assistants, agents, scripts, workflow automations, data tools and lightweight applications to address real Sourcing needs.
* Work across the technical lifecycle. Explore the data and systems involved, prototype an approach, test its behaviour, and improve it based on results and user feedback.
* Consider reliability, security, privacy, integration and maintainability. Recognise when a prototype needs further architecture or specialist engineering before wider use.
* Understand the workflow and its pain points, challenge assumptions, and identify whether the process should change before deciding what to automate.
* Explain technical possibilities clearly, translate needs into solution concepts, and collaborate with IT, architects, security and developers when required.
* Assess whether a solution improves the work; for example, by reducing effort or cycle time, improving decisions, or lowering errors;and share approaches that can be reused.
 **What you bring**

 **Technical capability**

* You can code and have personally built practical digital solutions. You can take an ambiguous problem through design, implementation and testing, explain how you improved your solution, and make progress without waiting for a detailed specification. Senior software engineering experience is not required.
* You have hands-on experience experimenting with AI, agents, automation or AI-enabled applications, and the technical curiosity to keep building and learning.
* You can work with data and understand, or are ready to develop your understanding of, APIs, integrations and the considerations involved in taking a prototype toward a production environment.
* You approach technical work thoughtfully: test what you build, learn from failures, and involve security, architecture or engineering specialists when appropriate.
* Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or equivalent technologies are relevant examples. The specific language, AI platform and cloud environment are flexible; demonstrated ability to build is what matters. Familiarity with Ericsson systems is not required.
 **Business and interpersonal capability: equally important**

* You are curious about how work operates and can get beneath an initial request to identify the real problem.
* You can analyse an end-to-end workflow, challenge existing steps, and consider a better way of working before automating it.
* You learn unfamiliar tools and business areas quickly, take initiative, and follow through to a usable outcome.
* You enjoy working directly with users, build trust, challenge constructively, and develop solutions with the people who will use them.
* You communicate clearly with both business colleagues and technical specialists, adapting your explanation to the audience.
 **What success looks like**

  

Success is not simply launching more tools. It is when teams adopt better ways of working, processes become simpler and more effective, and solutions deliver measurable business and commercial value. This may include reduced effort, shorter cycle times, improved decisions, fewer errors or stronger supplier outcomes. Successful approaches should be reusable across Sourcing.

 **Why join**

  

You will be embedded in the business and work close to the people and challenges your solutions are intended to address. Combining engineering, AI and data with Sourcing insight, you will take opportunities from discovery through prototype and, with the right partners, toward wider use. The aim is not to add tools for their own sake, but to help teams work differently and better, with measurable business and commercial impact.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. description:
### **Job description**


Vi är ett ledande konsultföretag inom mekanik och produktutveckling. Nu söker vi dig som har 2–3 års erfarenhet och vill ta nästa steg i din ingenjörskarriär.


Som konstruktör hos oss arbetar du huvudsakligen ute hos våra kunder, där du blir en del av deras utvecklingsteam och arbetar med kvalificerade produktutvecklingsprojekt. Våra uppdrag är ofta långsiktiga och ger dig möjlighet att komma nära produkterna, tekniken och utvecklingsprocesserna.


Det som utmärker oss är att vi är ett renodlat ingenjörsföretag. Alla våra medarbetare är ingenjörer och alla våra chefer har själva en ingenjörsbakgrund. Det innebär att du tillhör en organisation där teknisk kompetens, förståelse för ingenjörsrollen och viljan att utvecklas står i centrum. Vi har en platt organisation med korta beslutsvägar och en stark gemenskap mellan kollegor. Här möter du chefer som förstår din vardag som ingenjör och som värdesätter din kompetens och personliga utveckling.


### **Basic qualifications**


* Civilingenjörs- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik, mekanik, produktutveckling eller motsvarande.
* Cirka 2–3 års relevant erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion eller produktutveckling.
* Goda kunskaper i 3D-CAD, exempelvis Creo, SolidWorks, Inventor, CATIA eller Siemens NX.
* God förståelse för mekanisk konstruktion, materialval, toleranser och tillverkningsmetoder.
* Erfarenhet av konstruktionsarbete och produktutveckling i en industriell utvecklingsmiljö.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

### **Preferred additional skills, personal traits and experience**


Vi söker dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse och en stark ambition att utvecklas som ingenjör. Du är nyfiken, engagerad och tycker om att lösa komplexa tekniska problem.


Du är en person som gärna tar initiativ, tänker självständigt och vill bidra med idéer och lösningar. Du uppskattar att samarbeta med andra, samtidigt som du trivs med att ta eget ansvar och driva ditt arbete framåt.


Vi tror att du:


* Är driven och har en stark vilja att utvecklas och lära dig nya saker.
* Har ett genuint intresse för mekanik, konstruktion och produktutveckling.
* Är analytisk och lösningsorienterad med en god förmåga att hantera tekniska utmaningar.
* Tar ansvar för ditt arbete och har ambitionen att leverera hög kvalitet.
* Är kommunikativ, prestigelös och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra.
* Trivs i en organisation med korta beslutsvägar, stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka.
* Vill vara en del av ett kompetent nätverk där ingenjörskap och teknisk utveckling står i fokus.

### **We offer**


Hos oss står alltid konsulten i centrum, vår affär är uppbyggd kring vår förmåga att anställa och utveckla de bästa förmågorna inom våra områden.
Som privatägt bolag tittar vi inte på börskursen eller förbereder inför nästa kvartalsrapport, vi fokuserar istället på stabil och långsiktig utveckling, vilket bidrar med det samma för våra konsulter.


Utöver detta erbjuder vi:


* Distanskostnadsersättning vid arbete utanför kontoret
* Förmånsprogram via vår partner Benify
* Flexibla arbetstider
* Betald övertid enligt kollektivavtal
* Friskvårdsbidrag
* Bonus vid tips om rekrytering eller uppdrag
* Kollektivavtal via Almega

För att våra konsulter ska trivas så bra som möjligt och känna sig som en del av Sigma, även när man är placerad i kundens organisation, anordnar vi:


* Återkommande avdelningsmöten och aktiviteter
* Kompetensutveckling på konferenser och bolagsträffar
* Tillställningar och fester vid olika tillfällen under året

Som konsult hos oss får du arbeta tillsammans med de främsta utvecklingsintensiva företagen inom svensk industri. Uppdragen anpassas alltid i möjligaste mån, för att nivån ska bli så utvecklande och stimulerande som möjligt. Omkring dig kommer du ha många duktiga kollegor och ett aktivt erfarenhetsutbyte. Vår företagskultur präglas av entreprenörskap och korta beslutsvägar. Gemenskap, engagemang och glädje är viktiga element som vi anser skapar trivsel.

Väljer du oss på Capgemini får du en världsledare inom ingenjörstjänster – vi samlar ett globalt team av ingenjörer, forskare och arkitekter för att hjälpa världens mest innovativa företag att frigöra sin fulla potential. Från självkörande bilar till livräddande robotar – våra experter inom digital och mjukvaruteknik tänker utanför ramarna och levererar unika FoU- och ingenjörstjänster inom alla branscher. Bli en del av oss för en karriär full av möjligheter. Där du kan göra skillnad. Där ingen dag är den andra lik.


**Din roll**  

I denna roll kommer du att bidra i utvecklings- och verifieringsprojekt hos våra kunder, där du arbetar med testning, analys och kvalitetssäkring av tekniska system.
  

  

*I denna roll kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i:*  

  

• Arbeta inom olika högteknologiska produktområden och branscher.
  

• Ingå i ett dynamiskt team där din innovationsförmåga kommer att vara avgörande.
  

• Planera, utveckla och genomföra tester i relevanta testmiljöer.
  

• Analysera testresultat, identifiera avvikelser och bidra till förbättringsåtgärder.
  

• Samarbeta med olika kompetensområden och bidra med teknisk expertis genom hela utvecklingsprocessen.  

  

  

  

**Din profil**
  

• Ingenjörsexamen eller motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet
  

• 3+ års erfarenhet av HIL/SIL-testning och utveckling av testmiljöer.
  

• Erfarenhet av dSPACE, NI, CANoe, CANape eller vTESTstudio
  

• Programmeringskunskaper inom Python, C++, C# eller CAPL
  

• Kunskap inom CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet och UDS
  

• Erfarenhet av diagnostik, DTC:er och kravhantering
  

  

Denna tjänst kommer kräva svenskt medborgarskap samt att man blir godkänd i en säkerhetsprövning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen.  

  

  

  

**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas**
  

• Spännande uppdrag med cutting-edge teknologi.
  

• Ett väl uppbyggt förmånspaket för våra anställda.
  

• Tydlig karriärplan med skräddarsydda utvecklingsmöjligheter genom Capgemini Engineering Academy.
  

• Möjlighet att delta i globala ingenjörsgemenskaper och olika interna nätverk.
  

• Kollektivavtal som säkerställer dina anställningsvillkor.  

  

  

  

**Ansökan**
  

Observera att identitets- och bakgrundskontroller kommer genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.


**Om Capgemini**  

Capgemini är en global partner för affärs- och verksamhetstransformation i en tid präglad av AI. Vi hjälper företag och organisationer att skapa en intelligent och hållbar framtid genom att kombinera AI, teknik och mänsklig expertis. Tillsammans hjälper vi verksamheter att utveckla sina arbetssätt, stärka innovationsförmågan och skapa tillväxt. Genom helhetslösningar som omfattar strategi, teknik, engineering och intelligent operations kombinerar vi djup branschkunskap med marknadsledande expertis inom AI, moln och data. Det gör det möjligt för våra kunder att omsätta ambitioner till mätbara affärsresultat i stor skala.


Med stöd av ett starkt partnernätverk och nära 60 års erfarenhet är Capgemini en ansvarstagande global organisation präglad av mångfald, med över 410 000 medarbetare i fler än 50 länder. Koncernens omsättning uppgick till 22,5 miljarder euro under 2025.
